limitations: The ScienceBase item and its FGDC metadata XML are a dynamic release. The item's lastUpdated is 2026-10-13T20:02:48Z (16:02 -04:00) and the XML edition is 20261013. I fetched at about 16:05 -04:00, minutes after that update. The research ran 14:11 to 14:22 -04:00 and probably saw the previous edition. Quotes can drift with each update.

Edition cross-checks: the 2024-11-21 Word edition of the metadata carries the same wording for claims 1, 2, 4 and 8. The data.usgs.gov entry is the 2026-10-11 edition and carries the same abstract text for claims 3, 5 and 7.

Documentation only. I did not list or read the S3 bucket, did not run aws commands, and did not open S2_AQR_Scenes.zip or tutorial.zip. Encoding, no-data value, requester-pays status and the absence of a STAC catalog are not measured.

Absence claims (no latency, no service level, no STAC, no RequesterPays flag, no Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico) hold for these sources only: the registry page and YAML, the registry README, the ScienceBase item JSON, the FGDC XML, the 2024 Word metadata, the usgs.gov page, the data.usgs.gov entry and the AWS Marketplace listing. The ScienceBase item HTML is a script-rendered page, so I used its JSON.

The usgs.gov page is the only source that carries the full description in plain HTML. Lineage, completeness, accuracy and attribute facts exist only in the FGDC metadata files. Quotes from XML and Word are flattened element text.

Inconsistencies seen in the sources, outside the eight claims: the NDWI valid range prints as -10,000 to -10,000. UTM zone 17 prints a central meridian of -87, the same as zone 16. The metadata links registry.opendata.aws/usgs-sentinel-2-aqr-acolite-dsf, which returned HTTP 404. The metadata also names an imagery location, ngwos-rswq-development.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com, that the registry does not list. The metadata Globus origin_id (9e967cb6-...) differs from the registry and ScienceBase link (8fd8727f-...).

Downloads are in usgs/ and usgs/extra/ under the scratchpad validation folder (the extra folder holds the registry README, Marketplace page, data.usgs.gov page, Word metadata and the AWS sponsorship page). I read the Word file as a zip with Python and extracted nothing to disk. Nothing was executed.
